messages:
sasha: Heads-up — we got a firm ask from a healthcare customer for stronger tenant isolation + region residency. They want a launchable plan and rough timeline by EOW.
jia: Can you paste the konkret asks? that drives whether it's config, Dedicated, or Private.
mike: Summary from sales: per-tenant crypto (KMS), tenant-dedicated GPU pools (soft commit), regional pinning (EU only), and audit/log retention 
olivia: Also requires audit logs w/ retention policy + SOC2-like proof. privacy will need to confirm dataflow diagram.
sasha: Right. Sales phrased it as "isolation lane + contractual SLA" rather than full on-prem. Prefer hosted but isolated.
nate: Technical constraints: Dedicated pools means smaller batch sizes -> higher cost and liveness changes for KV cache. We'll need a fallback policy for capacity spikes.
emma: From product POV we should map this to a tiered offering: shared, isolated-soft (tenant slice on shared infra w/ logical isolation), isolated-hard (dedicated pool). define launch criteria per tier.
devops-bot: deploy-log: infra/provisioner v2.3 started for tenant-slicing experiment (job 8842).
mike: Proposed strategy: 1) scope MVP as "isolated-soft" with: per-tenant routing policy, per-tenant KMS bindings, and region pinning. 2) Make dedicated pools follow-on.
jia: Agree. Soft isolation cheaper and faster. But we need strong SLA gating for customers that sign up for it — explicit performance budget and fallbacks.
olivia: Compliance checklist (initial):
```
- data flow map signed
- KMS integration verified
- Access controls & audit logs enabled
- Legal clause for residency
- Pen test baseline
```
sasha: Launch criteria draft for isolated-soft MVP:
```
- Security sign-off (privacy + infra)
- Canary run (>=72h) with 0 P1 incidents
- Perf SLO: p95 latency < 350ms for tenant traffic under typical load
- Error rate < 0.5% sustained during canary
- Cost uplift estimate accepted by customer (ballpark +35%)
- Rollback and fallback policy documented
```

nate: Telemetry we need to gate: per-tenant token/sec, p50/p95/p99 latencies, kv-cache miss rate, autoscale events. We'll add these to the routing policy dashboards.
emma: Product asks for the customer-facing SLA language: what SLO we can commit to for soft isolation. If we can't hit 99.95 across all tenants, call it out.
mike: Cost note: soft isolation usually increases per-token cost ~20-40% due to reduced batching and cache locality. List mitigations: proactive prefix caching, request coalescing, quantization profiles for the tenant.
jia: Dependencies: autoscaler tweaks (infra), routing policy DSL extension (routing team), KMS per-tenant integration (security), console UI for tenant mapping (devex). Estimate parallel work: 6-8 wks for MVP if we prioritize.
olivia: Customer requires audit trail export. We need a retention/egress plan + template for NDAs.
sasha: Risk log: 
- capacity fragmentation -> noisy neighbor risk increases overall cost
- rollout complexity across regions -> potential imbalance
- monitoring blindspots for per-tenant degradation
We should add mitigation in runbook.

mike: Proposed rollout plan:
1) Design doc + acceptance criteria (this week) -> owner: jia
2) Proto config + canary in staging (2 wks) -> owner: nate
3) Security/compliance sign-off & pen test (parallel, 2-3 wks) -> owner: olivia
4) 72h prod canary at 1% traffic (observe metrics) -> owner: emma
5) Incremental ramp to 10% then full (gated) -> owner: sasha

emma: Customer negotiation notes: be explicit about latency deltas, cost uplift, and fallback (we can fail to shared lane with notice). Customer accepted staged migration.
jia: Questions: do we want to expose a "isolation level" enum in the API/console? Might simplify provisioning.
olivia: Yes — isolation_level: "shared" | "isolated_soft" | "dedicated". Link to legal templates once we pick level.

nate: One operational item: autoscaler metrics per pool must emit scaledown cooldowns to avoid oscillation when tenant traffic is bursty. I'll add to infra backlog.
sasha: Action items (owners):
- jia: author design doc + acceptance criteria by Fri
- nate: staging canary config + dashboard tiles by 2wks
- olivia: compliance checklist + NDA template by Fri
- emma: draft customer facing SLA language + cost uplift note by Tue
- mike: coordinate with sales for contract language and commercial impact

mike: Sounds good. If we aim for 6-8 wks MVP, call out a conservative SLA for now and tighten post-canary. +1 on enum in console.

olivia: +1 :thumbsup:

devops-bot: reminder: provisioning quota for dedicated pools currently requires quota increase request (ticket #2247).
sasha: We'll hold dedicated pool asks until the customer signs committed capacity. For now prioritized path: isolated-soft MVP.

mike: I'll update the roadmap doc and put a red/amber/green traffic-light for dependencies.

sasha: Thanks all — we'll sync Thurs 10am to review the design doc. If anyone can't make it ping here.
mike: I'll be there.
emma: might be late but will join 10:15 latest.

sasha: End."
